name: Rich Cauliflower Mac & Cheese with Sausage

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash cauliflower and cut off the leaves. Separate into small florets and cut the thick stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a large pot.

Add hot water (from the tap) to the pot, so that the cauliflower is just covered. Bring to a boil over high heat. Cook until fork-tender, 4-5 minutes. Drain in a colander; set aside to drain further. (Reserve pot for later use.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom; add the sausage. Cook, stirring often, until browned and cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Once done, transfer to a plate and reduce heat to low.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, wash, dry, and chop chives into small pieces; set aside.
Coarsely grate cheddar. Finely grate Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ (227 g) block cheddar cheese
170 g Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Melt more butter in skillet. Add garlic and stir until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Stir in cream, Dijon, paprika, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml heavy whipping cream
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp paprika
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the cream is warmed, add cheddar and Parmesan. Cook, stirring well, until the cheese is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Return drained cauliflower to the pot, add the cheese sauce, and stir until well coated.
Divide cheesy cauliflower between plates or bowls; sprinkle with sausage and chives. Enjoy!
